note: Seed catalog of popular MCP servers, Claude Code skills, and plugins. Entries with status 'reviewed' were hand-verified; 'unreviewed' entries were auto-discovered by the refresh scan and still need a human look. The 'url' is the install payload sent to the tool-install workflow.

entries.name: Filesystem
entries.description: Lets Claude read, write, and organize files on your computer inside folders you approve.
goodFor: Reading and editing local project files
Searching for files by name or content
features: Access limited to folders you allow
entries.requirements: No API key needed — just tell it which folders it can access
entries.popularity: One of the original official reference servers, bundled with most MCP setups

entries.name: Git
entries.description: Lets Claude look at a project's Git history, branches, and changes, and make commits.
entries.requirements: Needs a local Git repository — no extra account required
entries.popularity: Official reference server, widely used in coding workflows

entries.name: Memory
entries.description: Gives Claude a simple persistent notebook so it can remember facts between conversations.
entries.requirements: No setup — works out of the box
entries.popularity: Official reference server, commonly paired with personal-assistant setups

entries.name: Fetch
entries.description: Lets Claude fetch and read the content of a web page you give it a link to.
goodFor: Pulling text from a specific webpage
Summarizing an article or doc page
features: Converts web pages to clean text
entries.requirements: No setup — works out of the box
entries.popularity: Official reference server, one of the most commonly enabled

entries.name: Sequential Thinking
entries.description: Helps Claude break a hard problem into clear step-by-step reasoning before answering.
entries.requirements: No setup — works out of the box
entries.popularity: Official reference server, popular for planning-heavy tasks

entries.name: Everything (Test Server)
entries.description: A demo server that shows off everything the Model Context Protocol can do, mainly used to check a setup works.
goodFor: Testing that your MCP setup works
Learning what MCP servers can do
entries.requirements: No setup — works out of the box
entries.popularity: Official reference/test server maintained by the MCP team

entries.name: Time
entries.description: Gives Claude accurate current time and time zone conversion.
goodFor: Getting the correct current time or date
entries.requirements: No setup — works out of the box
entries.popularity: Official reference server, small but widely bundled

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Lets Claude read and manage your GitHub repos — issues, pull requests, code, and Actions.
entries.requirements: Needs a GitHub account (personal access token or OAuth)
entries.popularity: Official GitHub server (moved from the MCP reference repo), ~28k GitHub stars, actively maintained

entries.name: Brave Search
entries.description: Lets Claude search the web using Brave's search engine for up-to-date answers.
features: Web, image, video, and news search
entries.requirements: Needs a free or paid Brave Search API key
entries.popularity: Official successor to the original archived MCP reference Brave Search server

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Lets Claude read and post messages in your Slack workspace.
entries.requirements: Needs a Slack workspace with OAuth app setup
entries.popularity: Community-maintained successor to the original archived MCP Slack server

entries.name: Playwright
entries.description: Lets Claude control a real web browser — click, type, navigate — to test or use websites.
goodFor: Scraping or checking live website content
features: Uses the accessibility tree, not screenshots
Works with Chrome, Firefox, and WebKit
entries.requirements: No account needed — installs and runs locally
entries.popularity: Official Microsoft server, 30k+ GitHub stars

entries.name: Context7
entries.description: Gives Claude up-to-date, version-correct documentation for coding libraries instead of relying on possibly outdated memory.
goodFor: Getting current docs for a library or framework
entries.requirements: Works without a key on a limited free tier; API key recommended for higher limits
entries.popularity: Extremely popular among developers for keeping AI coding accurate

entries.name: Notion
entries.description: Lets Claude read and edit your Notion pages, databases, and notes.
goodFor: Reading and updating Notion pages and databases
entries.requirements: Needs a Notion integration token
entries.popularity: Official Notion server; Notion is now prioritizing its hosted remote version

entries.name: Stripe Agent Toolkit
entries.description: Lets Claude help manage Stripe payments, customers, subscriptions, and invoices.
features: Also available as a hosted remote server
entries.requirements: Needs a Stripe secret API key
entries.popularity: Official Stripe toolkit, widely used for commerce automation

entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: Lets Claude look up and help fix errors and performance issues tracked in Sentry.
goodFor: Connecting error data to code fixes
features: Claude Code plugin with auto-delegation subagent
entries.requirements: Needs a Sentry account and auth token
entries.popularity: Official Sentry server, actively released (v0.37+)

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.description: Lets Claude view and adjust your Cloudflare account settings — domains, security, and performance.
goodFor: Managing Cloudflare Workers and other services
features: Domain-specific servers for observability and browser rendering
entries.requirements: Needs a Cloudflare account and API token
entries.popularity: Official Cloudflare server, actively maintained

entries.name: Figma Dev Mode
entries.description: Lets Claude see your Figma designs and turn them directly into code.
goodFor: Turning a design into working front-end code
Extracting colors, spacing, and fonts from a design
Keeping code in sync with design files
features: Works locally via desktop app or via remote server
entries.requirements: Needs the Figma desktop app in Dev Mode (or a Figma account for the remote server)
entries.popularity: Official Figma feature, rolled out through 2025-2026

entries.name: Supabase
entries.description: Lets Claude manage your Supabase database and backend — tables, config, and queries.
entries.requirements: Needs a Supabase account and project
entries.popularity: Official Supabase server, commonly used in app-building workflows

entries.name: Atlassian (Jira & Confluence)
entries.description: Lets Claude read and update your Jira tickets and Confluence pages.
features: Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Compass access
entries.requirements: Needs an Atlassian Cloud account
entries.popularity: Official Atlassian server (Rovo MCP), generally available since February 2026

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.description: Lets Claude scrape and search live websites and turn them into clean, readable text.
features: Scrape, crawl, search, and extract tools
Free keyless tier for basic use
entries.requirements: Free tier works without a key; full features need a Firecrawl API key
entries.popularity: One of the most widely used web-scraping MCP servers

entries.name: Anthropic Document Skills (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel)
entries.description: Official Anthropic skills that let Claude create and edit real Word, PDF, PowerPoint, and Excel files.
goodFor: Generating a polished Word or PowerPoint document
Filling in or reading PDF forms
features: Covers docx, pdf, pptx, and xlsx
Same engine that powers Claude.ai's file creation
entries.requirements: No setup — built into Claude Code and Claude.ai
entries.popularity: Official Anthropic repo, 161k+ GitHub stars

entries.name: Code Review (Official)
entries.description: An official Anthropic plugin that reviews your code changes for bugs and quality issues before you commit.
goodFor: Getting a second opinion on a diff
entries.requirements: No setup — install from Anthropic's official plugin marketplace
entries.popularity: Bundled first-party plugin in Anthropic's official marketplace

entries.name: Security Guidance (Official)
entries.description: An official Anthropic plugin that checks your code changes for security problems.
goodFor: Reviewing a pull request for risky patterns
features: Works on the current branch's changes
entries.requirements: No setup — install from Anthropic's official plugin marketplace
entries.popularity: Bundled first-party plugin in Anthropic's official marketplace

entries.name: Frontend Design (Official)
entries.description: An official Anthropic plugin that helps Claude build polished, well-designed web interfaces.
goodFor: Improving the visual design of a web app
Building interfaces that look professional out of the box
features: Design guidance baked into Claude's suggestions
entries.requirements: No setup — install from Anthropic's official plugin marketplace
entries.popularity: Bundled first-party plugin in Anthropic's official marketplace

entries.name: Skill Creator (Official)
entries.description: An official Anthropic skill that helps you build your own custom skills for Claude Code.
goodFor: Creating a new custom skill from scratch
entries.requirements: No setup — install from Anthropic's official plugin marketplace
entries.popularity: Bundled first-party skill in Anthropic's official marketplace

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.description: A popular community plugin that gives Claude a full step-by-step engineering methodology — plan, build, test.
goodFor: Structuring a big coding project properly
Reducing rushed or sloppy AI coding
features: Installable via its own plugin marketplace
entries.requirements: Install via '/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace' — no API key needed
entries.popularity: Most-starred community Claude Code plugin, ~248k GitHub stars as of July 2026
